title: The Future of Email Marketing: Trends to Watch

facts.fact: The vendor states that email delivers 30:1 to 40:1 ROI in 2026 for small businesses and nonprofits when combined with automation and hyper-personalization.
facts.quote: Email remains a top ROI channel in 2026 for small businesses and nonprofits, delivering 30:1 to 40:1 returns

facts.fact: The article forecasts that by 2025, interactive emails will be used by 97% of marketers, with no source named for the figure on the page.
facts.quote: By 2025, interactive emails will be used by 97% of marketers

facts.fact: The article says some publishers have lost up to 80% of search traffic to phenomena like Google Zero.
facts.quote: some publishers have lost up to 80% of search traffic to phenomena like Google Zero

facts.fact: The article lists GDPR as applying in the EU since 2018 and CCPA/CPRA as applying in California among regulations reshaping list building.
